ctx.x: Yes, yes. Okay I have a few different things going. One thing is I’m doing these Louis Armstrong tributes. And those are going very well. And I was somewhat rejecting that, trying not to do those things anymore, but then I realized if I’m going to do a tribute to somebody else at least I’m fortunate enough to be doing it to the greatest of all time. The

great Louis Armstrong who I admire not just as a musician but as a person. Okay, and so other than that I also, I have my quartet things that I get booked and I go to Asia during summers and play in a club there in Taiwan and hang out with my son who lives there.
